items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: I was a Buck Sergeant before we left America

ctx.x: Oh that's, and the State Irish, I mean the State Scotch at that? Oh no wonder.

Well I told you, I had been busted I came back late from my leave before we left and I was a Buck Sergeant before we left America and they busted me quick. Or else Court-Martial me and I decided to get busted.
So that was that and so the colonel, cementing relations made me a sergeant again.
